Note to Entry no 1: The Company on May 12, 2025 had informed the stock exchange about the decision of the Board of Directors of Morepen Medipath Limited, a subsidiary Company, to incorporate a Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WoS) in the mainland at Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Note to Entry no 2: The Company on July 25, 2025 had informed the stock exchange about the decision of the Board of Directors of Morepen Medipath Limited, a subsidiary Company, to incorporate a Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WoS) under the name SIGMACHECK HEALTH PRIVATE LIMITED, Further, the said WoS of Morepen Medipath Limited and step down subsidiary of the company was incorporated on August 13, 2025.
Explanatory information with respect to the details of acquisition of shares or voting rights in unlisted companies during the quarter in terms of sub-para 1 of para A of Part A of Schedule III are given below:
1. The Company on July 31, 2025 had informed the stock exchange that pursuant to Agreement to Sell, for sale of 1.53 Crore (One Crore Fifty Three Lakh) equity shares of Dr. Morepen Limited (DML) by the company and Share Purchase cum Subscription Agreement entered amongst the DML and shareholders of Groom Town Private Limited (GTPL) for the acquisition of 100% equity stake of GTPL by DML and allotment of requisite number of equity shares to them by DML as purchase consideration, the shareholding of the company in DML came down from 80% to 19.94%, accordingly, DML ceased as an subsidiary and an associate of the company.
2. The Company on September 08, 2025 had informed the stock exchange about execution of a joint venture agreement between Morepen Medipath Limited (MML), a subsidiary of the company and Bimedical FZE, to form a Joint Venture Company (JVC), through which MML will acquire 50% shareholding in the proposed JVC and the company will indirectly hold 30% shares of the proposed JCV through MML. The disclosure for acquisition of shares or voting rights in said JVC, in terms of sub-para 1 of para A of Part A of Schedule III, will be made once it is incorporated.
